decisions.reason: The new font-identification and recommendation requirements do not change the brand colour specification; the colour-document access failure is already represented separately as execution evidence.
Requesting information about the existing logo lettering and complementary website fonts does not modify the selected logo's visual design.
The font-guidance change does not alter the required logo file-format coverage; file-opening outcomes in the same message are separate execution evidence already represented for this candidate.
The request for logo-lettering details and complementary font recommendations does not change the required background-box or colour variants.
The added font guidance concerns post-design brand reference information and does not change the completed concept or revision process.
